Liverpool Manager Iraola Admits Squad Thinness Amid Transfer Talk

Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola has stated that the team's squad is "still quite thin." He expressed confidence that the club will make further additions to the team. This admission comes amidst ongoing discussions about potential player transfers.
